provider_family: Iowa Secretary of State / Clarity Elections

endpoints.purpose: Clarity elections index; live entry identifies election 127077 as the Nov. 3, 2026 Iowa general election.
endpoints.observation: Index was publicly reachable through Civic Live Results MCP (the direct local index request was blocked with HTTP 403). Current entry resolves to data version 385082.

endpoints.purpose: Live detailed contest results with per-county candidate vote arrays and county names.
endpoints.observation: Contests include United States Senator (K=1000) and Governor and Lt. Governor (K=1500). For both races, P is a 99-element county-name list and V/T are aligned county candidate-vote and total-vote arrays.

endpoints.purpose: Live human-readable contest summary, candidate names, statewide totals, and reporting metadata.
endpoints.observation: Summary independently identifies both statewide contests and reports TP=99 and PR=78 for each. Candidate vote totals reconcile to the detailed county arrays.

county_coverage.county_identity_check: The detailed feed's P array contains the 99 distinct Iowa county names, including county-name edge cases O'Brien and Cerro Gordo, matching Iowa's 99-county geography. Candidate V arrays and total T arrays align by the same county-index order. County Cid values in these contests are mixed-area codes and should not be interpreted as county FIPS identifiers.
county_coverage.note: The feed has 99 county slots; zero totals in a live snapshot indicate no votes reported for that county at capture time and must not be treated as verified final zero votes. Summary PR=78 is preserved as the provider's reporting field; it is not a county count.

source.provider: Iowa Secretary of State, via Clarity Elections results host
source.attribution: Attribute live election results to the Iowa Secretary of State and Clarity Elections.
source.license: Public unauthenticated HTTPS JSON feed; no explicit machine-readable reuse license was verified. Confirm terms before commercial redistribution.

limitations: This is an unofficial election-night live snapshot, not certified results. Values can change as counties report and the Clarity data version updates.

The local index and electionsettings.json requests returned HTTP 403 during this check. The election ID and version were observed via the publicly callable Civic Live Results MCP; the versioned detailed and summary JSON payloads had been fetched successfully and saved locally at 2026-11-04T04:29:17Z.
The county-name array aligns county votes but the associated Cid values are not county FIPS codes. Use county names or an independently validated name-to-FIPS crosswalk.
The summary reports TP=99 and PR=78; retain these provider fields without assuming PR means 78 counties.

preferred_verified_source.provider: Reported election returns via The New York Times
preferred_verified_source.message: 99 counties with published returns. Source times apply to the published race feed; individual local update times are not supplied. Unofficial counts; no forecast or expected-vote estimates are included.
